A post from her @ElizabethHolmes account (status 2103657789423792441) apparently set off a race of Theranos coin launches. This token is a Meteora virtual-curve launch that migrated to PumpSwap about 16 minutes before detection. It spiked to about $269k market cap and fell 55% in the last 5 minutes, to about $104–115k. An earlier pump.fun Theranos token (AEUbt...pump) has higher market cap, liquidity and volume.
